notes:
- The title page is a full-screen page: Opening a title no longer raises a draggable sheet. The Info page fills the screen, with its banner under the status bar, a spring entrance, the palette editor as an overlay and My Entry on the capsule. Close and Back are the only ways out, and the editor has its own close control.
- Friends who plan, drop or pause sit beside the ones watching: The friends row keeps every status AniList records and names it - Watching, Reading, Planning, Paused, Dropped, Completed, Rewatching. Active entries lead, and a plan or a drop sits in the same row instead of being filtered away.
- First-run setup is a six-page walk: A welcome page and one question per page, all full screen, with Back, Skip and Next or Finish, a capsule progress bar and a spring that slides each page in from the side.
- A studio and a face remember where you were: Studio pages resume their scroll position and their shelf-or-wall layout, and character and staff profiles resume the body scroll of that exact person. The memory lasts for the open app, and nothing is written into Settings.
- The synopsis clamps inside a quote too: A collapsed synopsis now clamps quoted paragraphs as well as plain ones, so a quoted blurb no longer prints in full under a Read more button with nothing left to reveal. The friends card also says when it is checking your follows rather than appearing suddenly.
